method: Production civilian and street physics modules in the same Cannon world, real fixed/kinematic contacts, full authored street extraction, swept accepted movement, and render-derived corpse bounds.

results.test: Forward and reverse vehicle deaths launch in the accepted direction, tumble, land, and reset
Thrown civilian collides with a fixed wall instead of passing through it
A moving kinematic car transfers momentum to a physical corpse through Cannon contacts
A physical corpse blocks further bullets and receives impulse without another casualty
Persistent corpse cleanup bounds dynamic assemblies and preserves grounded dead people
Movable bin receives shot and bumper impulses, lands on raised pavement, and resets
Rotated visible street furniture blocks shots to civilians behind it
An existing parked vehicle becomes physical, takes impact damage, and restores its original pose
Spatial broadphase preserves all dynamic contact candidates through movement, sleep, removal, and freezing
Full authored street geometry is solid using bounded compound tiles and all twelve physical bins
